label: Copy-phase fed-back digit 3, early in the copy (outputs 2-4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, only when the input token is the digit 3 (the model has just emitted a 3 and it is fed back), and only early in the copy: recall_idx 2-4, i.e. the 3 was original token 1, 2 or 3. It never fires on 3 in the original phase, on the delimiter, or on any other token. Magnitude is largest when the 3 sits at original position 1 (recall_idx 2; top examples all have the form x 3 ... <DEL> x [3]), and it falls off with later positions: recall_idx 2 carries about 58% of activation mass, 3 about 36%, and 4 only about 6% with weak, often-missing activations (most false positives are there). Fed-back 3s at recall_idx 1 or >= 5 give only trace activations. Dev split: P 0.82, R 0.98, F1 0.89, mass recall 0.999.

issues: The predicate misses a systematic gap: the feature is silent when the fed-back 3 arrives on the LAST copy step (to_go == 0). Precision of in_tok==3 by (recall_idx, L) on dev: r=3,L=4 (the final step) 0.010, while r=3 at L>=5 is about 1.0. r=4,L=5 (the final step) 0.050. r=2,L=3 (the final step) has 0 activations, and the profile shows L=3 with 0 active steps in total. Every other r=2 and r=3 cell is about 1.0.

Most of the original predicate's false positives come from these final-step cases, not from 'weak recall_idx 4' as the explanation says. Adding (to_go>=1) raises dev precision from 0.816 to 0.923 while recall only goes from 0.985 to 0.981. Test F1 goes from 0.890 to 0.950.

At recall_idx 4, activity also falls with how close the step is to the end: precision is 0.05 at L=5 (final step), 0.53 at L=6 (to_go=1), and 0.74-0.81 at L=7-9. The leftover false positives (3 at original position 3) are a graded fall-off, not a sharp cutoff.

Confirmed claims: the feature never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and fires only on in_tok 3 (100% of activation mass). Activation mass by recall_idx is 2: 58%, 3: 36%, 4: 5.5%, and recall_idx 1 and 5+ give only traces. The reported test scores (P 0.814, R 0.983, F1 0.890) reproduce.
The label overclaims slightly. It suggests any early-copy fed-back 3 fires, but the feature does not fire when that 3 is the last input of the sequence (e.g. L=4 with the 3 at original position 2).
